newsitem.title: JAPAN: JAPAN JUNE RUBBER OUTPUT FOR TYRES UP 4.2% YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: JAPAN JUNE RUBBER OUTPUT FOR TYRES UP 4.2% YR/YR.

text.p: Japanese rubber output for tyres totalled 95,715 tonnes in June, up 4.2 percent from the same month in the previous year and up 10.6 percent from May, the Japan Automobile Tyre Manufacturers' Association said on Tuesday.
Domestic rubber shipments in June amounted to 52,534 tonnes, up 1.9 percent from the previous year and up 11.2 percent from May, the industry body said.
Exports of rubber for tyres in June totalled 41,645 tonnes, up 10.1 percent from the previous year and up 10.0 percent from May, it said.
In the first six months of this year, rubber output for tyres totalled 545,954 tonnes, up 3.2 percent from the same period a year earlier, it said.
